response.sql: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film AS f LEFT JOIN film_actor AS fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM actor_counts), above_first AS (SELECT ac.film_id, ac.actor_count, ac.actor_count - a.avg_count AS excess_over_first FROM actor_counts AS ac CROSS JOIN first_average AS a WHERE ac.actor_count > a.avg_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM above_first) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(af.actor_count), 0) AS total_actor_count, AVG(af.excess_over_first) AS avg_excess_over_first, AVG(af.actor_count - sa.avg_count) AS avg_excess_over_second FROM above_first AS af CROSS JOIN second_average AS sa WHERE af.actor_count > sa.avg_count
